item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=How+do+finite+or+noisy+memory+constraints+modify+the+fundamental+lower+bounds+on+thermodynamic+dissipation+in+cyclic+information+engines%3F&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"CHARMM at 45: Enhancements in Accessibility, Functionality, and Speed.\", \"abstract\": \"Since its inception nearly a half century ago, CHARMM has been playing a central role in computational biochemistry and biophysics. Commensurate with the developments in experimental research and advances in computer hardware, the range of methods and applicability of CHARMM have also grown. This review summarizes major developments that occurred after 2009 when the last review of CHARMM was published. They include the following: new faster simulation engines, accessible user interfaces for convenient workflows, and a vast array of simulation and analysis methods that encompass quantum mechanical, atomistic, and coarse-grained levels, as well as extensive coverage of force fields. In addition to providing the current snapshot of the CHARMM development, this review may serve as a starting point for exploring relevant theories and computational methods for tackling contemporary and emerging problems in biomolecular systems.
